title: Saybo - Non Stop Garba
artist: Nisha Upadhyay, Achal Maheta, Atul Purohit
label: Soor Mandir / SM Digital
description: A 15-track Saybo Garba programme credited to Nisha Upadhyay, Achal Maheta and Atul Purohit. The catalogue preserves 1995 as the strongest original-date evidence while using the 2022 Soor Mandir / SM Digital 15-track reissue as the canonical track structure.
notes: Apple Music song metadata dates the underlying Saybo programme to 17 July 1995. A third-party archival index reports 1998, while the current Soor Mandir digital reissue is dated 2022 and Spotify exposes a later shortened 11-track edition. The 15-track Amazon/Apple reissue is canonical for track structure; 1995 is retained as the strongest original-date evidence.

title: Garbi
label: Sur Sagar
description: A 2024 Sur Sagar release by Hardik Dave and Rahul Munjariya, catalogued as 14 entries across Mataji devotional and traditional Garba in an album-plus-continuous-version format.
notes: Spotify displays 51:42 at album level while the displayed exact track durations sum slightly differently; album duration is intentionally left null rather than forcing a conflicting value.

title: Prachin Garba

description: A two-track 2024 long-form traditional set by Hardik Dave, issued by Musica Productions and catalogued across traditional Garba and Raas/Dandiya.
